name: The State of Lakeshire
summary: Lakeshire's defenders face attacks, and Magistrate Solomon calls on Stormwind for aid. His report urges General Marcus Jonathan to send royal reinforcements against the crisis in Redridge.

sections.title: A Cry for Aid
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon writes that attacks threaten Lakeshire. Blackrock orcs and gnolls press the town, and its defenders cannot hold the borders forever. Couriers carry his dispatch west along the road to Elwynn Forest. Solomon asks the Stormwind Army to protect the kingdom's eastern reach.

sections.title: Bureaucracy and Deadlock
sections.body: At Stormwind's gates, General Marcus Jonathan receives Solomon's report. He respects the magistrate's standing and understands the danger, but cannot move the army alone. Deployments need the crown's consent. So Lakeshire's plea must wait for a council with the young King and regent Bolvar Fordragon.

faq.q: What is The State of Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon's official dispatch describes the military danger facing Lakeshire and asks Stormwind for troop reinforcements.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive this dispatch?
faq.answer: General Marcus Jonathan is meant to receive the dispatch. He commands the Stormwind city guard and royal forces and is stationed at Stormwind's gates.

faq.q: Why does Lakeshire need royal reinforcements?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs, Shadowhide gnolls, and local murlocs keep besieging Lakeshire, overwhelming its town guard. The settlement needs royal reinforcements.

faq.q: Does General Marcus Jonathan send help immediately?
faq.answer: No. General Marcus Jonathan agrees the crisis is severe, but needs the King's formal approval to deploy the army. The request must first go through royal review.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the report shows how exposed the outer settlements are and how political delays in the capital hold up military aid.
As a human of the kingdom, carrying this report shows how the common folk of Redridge are losing their ties to the distant crown in Stormwind.
